required_uploads: current Base Notes PM Starter ZIP (contains Base Notes PM + bundled Curriculum Philosophy)
course_detection_rule: The Base Notes PM identifies Algebra 1 from this Framework; the teacher does not need to name the course in the prompt.
base_notes_role: owns universal Notes build order, canonical-Bank consumption, student/teacher HTML mechanics, Base class floor, QA boundary, ZIP deliverable
framework_role: owns Algebra-specific Notes philosophy/organization, exact-I-can instructional clustering, reading benchmark, S&D implementation, Math Notes abundance, approved typography/graph/table/workspace scale, visual/layout extensions, sources, representations, deployed paths, and graph tooling
bank_role: owns canonical WTC / Notes Example / Notes YTI wording, values, figures, and answer/solution intent
pair_rule: Current Algebra Bank contract normally provides six Example/YTI pairs per section, but Notes must trust and use every canonical pair actually present rather than a hard-coded count.
visible_numbering_rule: Visible Example/YTI numbering follows rendered Notes teaching order; canonical IDs remain metadata.
css_rule: Production HTML links exactly base.css then notes.css. Framework-approved layout/typography extensions are recorded in contracts/notes_visual_contract.json; do not add a third production stylesheet just to carry the reference patch.
layout_enforcement: Algebra graph/table presentation classes and current visual numeric defaults are mandatory; CSS rules do not count as implemented unless the HTML uses the classes, and stale values from older Framework versions are prohibited.
